slides.heading: Type Conversion
slides.body: Type Conversion is part of Mathematical and String Operations. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: Type Conversion
slides.body: Type conversion changes a value from one data type to another. For example, int("25") changes text into a number.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: Type conversion is like converting pesos to centavos. The value is related, but the form changes.
